cases.title: Upgrade；恢复后幂等、持久化、Desired State与实际状态一致
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PARTIAL excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Install (operation=deploy, artifact qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-payload-a1, v1.0): real Hub DEPLOY_REQUEST over the owned Agent session -> owned systemd unit nodesteer-qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-app.service active, /opt/qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2/app/bin/app byte-identical to the uploaded artifact SHA 0bc5df26d956108d90f7b03b7b5aed75be41bcaea16db87bef0376d954917132 (mode 0755), config /opt/qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2/app/config/app.env SHA == SHA256("APP_MODE=v1\n"), enable symlink present, unit registered in the Agent unit_registry, deployment journal DONE, Execution SUCCESS, Hub Application node state version=1.0 health=healthy.

Install idempotency: repeating the same deploy returned SUCCESS with identical binary and unit-file SHAs, exactly one owned unit file and one enable symlink, still active, no additional Execution; a Desired-State re-assertion (assign again -> resync) produced no new deployment journal row and no new Execution.

Upgrade v1.0 -> v2.0 (operation=upgrade, artifact qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-payload-a2, app revision 1 -> 2): binary SHA == c92707bdc68e8a8dfb75807532d19d5c9a808a0b92dfac1e473ae2b62bc39396, config SHA == SHA256("APP_MODE=v2\n"), unit ExecStart args updated to --profile=v2, unit active, Hub node state version=2.0 health=healthy, Execution SUCCESS, journal DONE.

Backup Current (PRODUCT.md §39/§41): the deployment row backup_path content SHA 0bc5df26d956108d90f7b03b7b5aed75be41bcaea16db87bef0376d954917132 equals the previously installed v1 artifact SHA 0bc5df26d956108d90f7b03b7b5aed75be41bcaea16db87bef0376d954917132, i.e. the previous version was retained before the atomic replace.
Upgrade idempotency: repeating the v2 upgrade returned SUCCESS with unchanged binary/unit SHAs and a single owned unit.

Persistence: owned Agent restart (SIGTERM/Popen, no systemd unit involved) left the binary, unit file, enable symlink, unit_registry row and deployment journal intact; the managed unit stayed active and the node returned online/synced.
Desired State == actual state: Hub Application revision/version/artifact_id == Agent local synced definition (version/artifact_id) == on-disk binary SHA == active unit == node state healthy 2.0.

remaining_or_limitations: Deployment-journal from_version is written from the synced Application definition at deploy time, not from the previously installed version: the v1->v2 upgrade row shows from_version=to_version=2.0. The previously installed version is instead proven by the pre-deploy binary SHA (A1) and by the backup content SHA == A1. Recorded as a product observation, not a case failure.
An explicit re-deploy rewrites the binary byte-identically (mtime changes); idempotency was therefore measured as "identical content SHA, single unit, no extra journal/Execution", not as "no write".

No browser UI was driven for this batch; caller-side feedback is the Hub API (POST /api/applications/{id}/deploy response, GET /api/executions/{id}, GET /api/applications/{id}/state). The Applications/Executions UI for this feature is already covered by the reused SYS-44 evidence (managed-app-ui.json).

The PREPARING-phase crash recovery mentioned in the batch plan (P0-002 attempt03) was not re-executed for AR-27; crash recovery is instead exercised end-to-end in AR-29 (rollback after a crash in VERIFYING). The previously recorded PREPARING evidence remains available for Root review.

cases.title: SYS-50 Health 失败：停止新版本、恢复 Binary/Config/Unit、Health 后记录 ROLLBACK_SUCCESS。
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Upgrade v2.0 -> v3.0 with artifact qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-payload-a3 (binary exits immediately) and health_check.type=systemd served from the real Hub definition.

Ordered journal/disk timeline sampled every ~0.5s against the Agent deployment journal plus the host: VERIFYING (binary SHA 7a86dfd6b073cbc72b89addb7d65948d7aa130d84fad6775d8328cb6c02f7787 == v3 artifact, unit inactive) -> ROLLING_BACK (binary SHA c92707bdc68e8a8dfb75807532d19d5c9a808a0b92dfac1e473ae2b62bc39396 == restored v2 artifact, config SHA v2, unit file back to the v2 arguments, unit active) -> DONE. The ROLLING_BACK sample proves "stop new version, restore previous binary, restore previous config/unit, daemon-reload, start previous, re-check health" in one observation window.

Verdict/caller feedback: Execution FAILED with block_reason "health check failed"; Hub Application node state version=3.0 health=unhealthy error="health check failed" (no false DONE/healthy); unit nodesteer-qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-app.service active and healthy on the restored v2.
Negative proof: the v3 binary SHA never remains installed after rollback (binary SHA == v2), and the health check is re-run against the restored unit.

remaining_or_limitations: The product records a successful rollback as ROLLING_BACK -> DONE in the deployment journal (PRODUCT.md §42 lists PREPARING/STOPPED/REPLACED/STARTED/VERIFYING/DONE/ROLLING_BACK). There is no distinct "ROLLBACK_SUCCESS" journal phase to assert; the success verdict is carried by the Execution result (FAILED + block_reason) plus the restored-and-healthy v2 state, and the Agent's deploy result sets rollback=true (visible only in the Hub process log, not exposed through the API).
ROLLING_BACK lasted ~1s and was captured by ~0.5s journal sampling; the ordering proof does not depend on catching it (the binary SHA flips from v3 to v2 between the VERIFYING and final samples).

The health failure is induced by an owned artifact whose binary exits immediately, so the unit never becomes active; TCP/HTTP/COMMAND health-check failure modes were not each exercised in this batch (only the systemd type).

cases.title: Health Failure；恢复后幂等、持久化、Desired State与实际状态一致
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Health failure and rollback: same event as SYS-50 (upgrade to qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-payload-a3 fails the systemd health check, ROLLING_BACK restores the v2 binary/config/unit, unit active again, journal DONE, Execution FAILED "health check failed", node state unhealthy).

Recovery: restoring the Hub Application definition to v2.0 (qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-payload-a2) and re-running the real upgrade produced Execution SUCCESS; Hub revision/version/artifact_id == Agent local definition == on-disk binary SHA c92707bdc68e8a8dfb75807532d19d5c9a808a0b92dfac1e473ae2b62bc39396 == active unit == node state version=2.0 health=healthy (Desired State == actual state).
Idempotency after recovery: an additional identical deploy returned SUCCESS with unchanged binary SHA and an active unit.
Persistence after mismatch: restarting the owned Agent left binary/unit/enable symlink/unit_registry/deployment journal intact (quick_check=ok) and the managed unit active.

remaining_or_limitations: Recovery required restoring the Hub Application definition (v3.0 -> v2.0): the product does not revert the Hub-side definition after a rolled-back upgrade, so Desired State (definition) and actual state only converge after the explicit definition update or a successful re-deploy. Reported as an observation; the case dimension "after recovery Desired State == actual state" is satisfied by the v2.0 restore.
The health check type exercised is systemd; TCP/HTTP/COMMAND failure paths are not covered in this batch.

cases.title: Rollback；恢复后幂等、持久化、Desired State与实际状态一致
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Crash inside an in-flight upgrade: upgrade v2.0 -> v4.0 (artifact qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2-payload-a4, health_check systemd attempts=12 interval=6) reached journal phase VERIFYING with the v4 binary already installed on disk; the owned Agent process was then SIGKILLed (real process kill, Hub Execution still PENDING; deployment row left at VERIFYING).

Journal-driven rollback on restart: the Agent log shows "recovering incomplete deployment id=... phase=VERIFYING"; the deployment row went ROLLING_BACK -> DONE and the host came back to binary SHA c92707bdc68e8a8dfb75807532d19d5c9a808a0b92dfac1e473ae2b62bc39396 (v2), v2 config, unit file with --profile=v2, unit active, registry unchanged.
Interrupted Execution finalization: the crashed DEPLOY_REQUEST execution was finalized FAILED with block_reason "agent_restarted" (no stale RUNNING/PENDING row).

Recovery + idempotency + persistence: two subsequent real v2.0 deploys returned SUCCESS with unchanged binary SHA/active unit; the Hub definition version equals the Agent local definition and the node state is healthy 2.0 after recovery.

remaining_or_limitations: The crash is a harness SIGKILL of the owned child Agent process (a real process death, no product source change); Product-internal panics are not simulated.

The recovery rollback re-runs the health check taken from the synced v4.0 definition (systemd) and the restored v2 unit satisfies it on the first attempt, so the rollback's re-verify step is real but did not need to wait.

Convergence of Desired State with actual state again required restoring the Hub definition to v2.0 (see AR-28 note); the journal DONE after recovery proves the deployment transaction is not left half-open.

cases.title: SYS-52 Backup 缺失、权限不足、磁盘不足的明确失败。
cases.canonical_before: NOT_RUN (repair build not executed; legacy baseline PASS excluded per remaining_dimensions)

description: Baseline: v2.0 installed and active (binary c92707bdc68e8a8dfb75807532d19d5c9a808a0b92dfac1e473ae2b62bc39396, unit active) so the pre-deploy Backup Current stage has a real previous version to copy.

Missing/unusable backup destination (dangling symlink at /var/lib/nodesteer-qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2/data/applications): Execution FAILED, block_reason "create backup directory failed: mkdir /var/lib/nodesteer-qa-sysb11-43f7a4f057f2/data/applications: file exists"; binary/unit SHAs, unit state and unit_registry unchanged (no half replacement).

Permission denied (owned backup dir made immutable with chattr +i; needed because the Agent runs as root): Execution FAILED, block_reason "backup binary failed: open .../backup-<uuid>.binary: operation not permitted"; no host mutation.

Disk insufficient (owned 128 KiB tmpfs mounted at the backup dir; the current v2 binary is ~1 MiB): Execution FAILED, block_reason "backup binary failed: write .../backup-<uuid>.binary: no space left on device"; no host mutation.
Positive control: a backup directory that is simply missing is created by the product and the deploy succeeds (Execution SUCCESS) - a missing path alone is not a silent-success error case.
All three negative modes reported a non-empty failure reason to the Hub (Execution FAILED + Application node state health=unhealthy) and left the running v2 application untouched.

remaining_or_limitations: The three seams are harness-side (owned path only, released immediately after each scenario): chattr +i immutable directory for the permission-denied mode (the Agent runs as root, so mode-based denial is not applicable) and a 128 KiB tmpfs mount for the disk-full mode; both produce real kernel errors (EPERM / ENOSPC) inside the untouched product backup code path.

"Backup 缺失" is covered as "backup destination present but unusable/not creatable"; a directory that is genuinely absent is created by the product (positive control above). The product's separate "source file absent" semantics (backup sentinel "absent:") was not the target of this case.

The deployment journal records PREPARING -> DONE even for a prepare-stage failure (a verify-absent sentinel); the failure verdict is carried by the Execution (FAILED) and the Application node state (unhealthy + error). Recorded as an observation, not a case failure.
When the backup write fails mid-way a partial backup file remains in the backup directory (observed in the tmpfs scenario and removed with the tmpfs); no application host file was modified.

seams.missing_backup_destination: dangling symlink at the backup dir
seams.backup_permission_denied: chattr +i on the owned backup dir
seams.backup_disk_full: tmpfs size=128k,mode=0755 mounted at the backup dir

harness_failures_retained: attempt01: over-strict assertion (deployment-journal from_version must equal the previously installed version) aborted the batch after health_rollback; the pre-abort evidence was real (install, upgrade, systemd health-fail rollback VERIFYING->ROLLING_BACK->DONE) and is retained under evidence/attempt01-harness-bug/. Cleanup was still clean (oracle_clean=true).

attempt02: the dependency-skip logic treated a skipped phase as runnable, so follow-up phases ran with the Hub definition still pointing at the unhealthy v3 artifact; retained under evidence/attempt02-harness-bug/ (oracle clean).
attempt03: KeyError on the inventory key name (etc_systemd_owned vs etc_systemd_owned_leftovers) inside the SYS-52 helper; retained under evidence/attempt03-harness-bug/ (oracle clean).

attempt04: one mislabeled evidence key (artifact_cache_has_v3) was computed from the deployment backup directory listing rather than the Agent artifact cache; renamed in-place with a harness_key_relabel note in evidence/phase9-sys50-health-rollback.json.

Observation during attempt02/attempt04: "systemctl list-units" also lists the systemd-generated <data>-applications.mount unit for the tmpfs seam, so the SYS-52 host-unit check was based on the /etc/systemd/system directory listing instead.
